title: Break From Reality Escape Rooms
specs: Immersive rooms with puzzles integrated into the story environment
Family-friendly with no deliberately scary elements
Unique puzzles based on real themes like Viking lore and magic
If any player is 15 or under, at least one adult must be present
Children under 5 must stay in stroller or be held during the game
Players should be old enough to read and understand puzzles
Rooms are private and reserved by the hour for individual groups
Minimum group charge is 3 tickets or $102
includes: Game Master observation during the entire game
Use of immersive themed rooms with puzzles
gap: Exact age minimum not stated, only guidance about children under 5 and under 15
blurb: Guests participate in 60-minute immersive escape room adventures where they solve themed puzzles to complete a mission. Each room is designed to feel like a real story environment with puzzles integrated into the setting. Rooms are private and reserved by the hour for individual groups.
extraNote: All bookings and games are non-refundable · Rescheduling allowed with at least 24 hours notice · Arrive 15 minutes early for check-in and briefing · Late arrivals may start late with time deducted from 60 minutes · No photos, recordings, or live streams allowed inside rooms · All players must sign a waiver before playing · Fair Oaks Corporate Center II, 11230 Waples Mill Road, Suite 110, Fairfax, VA 22030
